senses.gloss: m. (צְהַר, cmp. preced. wds.) white spot, indication of leprosy.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 86a:2">Gitt. 86ᵃ</cite> (in a formula of sale of a slave) free from any organic defect <he>ומן שחין דנפק עד ט׳ חדת וכ׳</he> and from any eruption that has come out, down to ‘white spot’, recent or old. [Alf. <he>ומן כל שחין עד צהר</he>; Asheri <he>מן ט׳</he>. The misconception of our w. by commentators, as if denoting a foreign numeral (2 or 4 years) arose from a tradition concerning the definition of <cite ref="P01532"><he>עתיק</he></cite>.]
